item.description:
Drag to Snap

Drag a window and a translucent preview shows where it will land. Drop it, and it snaps into place. Pick which Quick Snap layout the zones come from in Settings, and choose whether the preview appears anywhere on screen or only near the edges.

Hold Command while dragging to place a window freely without snapping.

Fixes

  • Deleting a preset no longer quietly breaks the hotkey or drag-snap layout that used it.
  • Saved size presets now work when assigned to a hotkey.
  • The Settings window remembers its size and position instead of resetting every time it opens.
  • Preset names are checked for duplicates and for clashes with built-in layouts.
  • The manual size fields no longer accept zero or negative values.
  • Saved presets are easier to read in Settings.
